description: Dependency updates through the Mend Renovate GitHub App.

Every update is a pull request someone reads and merges by hand: no automerge. A release is proposed only once it is 3 days old, because a hijacked release is usually pulled within hours (trivy, March 2026); vulnerability alerts skip that wait and the schedule.
Commit messages follow the repository's conventional commits (chore(deps), fix(deps) for a vulnerability fix); their text is generated by the bot, in English.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Opened at once, outside the schedule and without minimumReleaseAge. Needs the repository's Dependency graph and Dependabot alerts (not Dependabot security updates).

customManagers.description: The commit of the backend repository whose deploy/ci/ scripts and pinned tools this repository runs (.backend-commit, one full SHA, read by the Makefile and the workflows): the newest commit of its main.

The release of the gateway's REST contract the API types are generated from (api/contract.json: repository, version and the digest of that version's manifest), an OCI artifact the backend pushes to GHCR, looked up on the docker datasource like an image.

packageRules.description: chore(deps) for every update; vulnerabilityAlerts above turns a vulnerability fix into fix(deps).
Digest-only updates (an image rebuilt under the same tag) not covered by a group below: one weekly pull request.
GitHub Actions, pinned to a full commit SHA with the version in a comment: one pull request for non-major updates. A major gets its own pull request, since a workflow may need changes for it.

The packages of package.json stay exact versions: a range added later gets a pull request that pins it. pnpm-lock.yaml is updated with them and pnpm dedupe runs after (postUpdateOptions); pnpm reads pnpm-workspace.yaml, so its own 3-day wait also holds for the transitive packages the update pulls in. lockFileMaintenance stays off: it rewrites the whole lockfile without the 3-day wait.

npm packages and pnpm itself (packageManager of package.json), non-major: one pull request. A major gets its own, or one per monorepo (next with eslint-config-next, react with react-dom) through config:recommended.

The Sentry SDK (@sentry/nextjs) and the Sentry CLI that uploads its source maps (sentry, make sourcemaps) move together in one pull request, majors included: the CLI matches the bundle's chunks to their maps by the debug IDs the SDK's build plugin writes, so the two are checked as a pair (make sourcemaps, SVP_E2E_GLITCHTIP=1 make e2e). separateMajorMinor is off for them: otherwise a major of one goes to its own branch (renovate/major-sentry) while a minor of the other released with it goes to renovate/sentry.

Node moves in one pull request in .nvmrc (read by the Makefile, actions/setup-node and nvm), in engines of package.json and in the base images of the Dockerfile: the node builder image and the distroless Node runtime, whose digest updates come here too.
The Node major of the distroless runtime is part of its image name (nodejs26-debian13), which Renovate never changes: it only updates the digest of the nonroot tag.
prBodyNotes: A new Node major: change the runtime image of the Dockerfile by hand in this pull request (gcr.io/distroless/nodejs<major>-debian13:nonroot, pinned by the digest of its index from docker buildx imagetools inspect), or the image keeps running the old major.

packageRules.description: The backend commit: one pull request whenever main of the backend moves, read with the backend's log before merging (its deploy/ci/ scripts and pinned tools run here from then on). Its own commits need no 3-day wait.
A new release of the contract is the backend's own, signed by its release workflow: no 3-day wait. The pull request must carry the API types generated from it.
prBodyNotes: A new release of the gateway's contract: run make generate in this pull request and commit gen/api.d.ts (make generate-check fails until they match); a major version is a breaking change, so adapt the code that calls the gateway too.
